name: check_my_figures
description: With the person's three account files loaded, the person says they spend about 5,000 a month and have 10,000 saved. The files show about 5,640.53 going out a month over the last three full months and 9,230.13 in savings: two data findings, both put to the person and decided before the forecast is run with the figures they chose.
lines: Can I cover each wedding payment? The wedding is on 12 June 2027 and I expect 200 guests, at 230 each for dinner. Costs that do not depend on guests: 5,000 for extras, 2,000 for the DJ and 1,500 for the bar. The first payment is 6,000, due in 21 days, and it counts towards the total. The second is half of what remains, due 30 days before the wedding, and the third is the other half, due 14 days before. I take home 10,000 a month and spend about 5,000 a month. I have 10,000 saved for the wedding in my savings account. My families will give 20,000 on 29 May 2027. Please go ahead with those figures.
